assertions.name: no_stale_probes
assertions.unit: boolean (1.0 = no probe witness > threshold days behind .md)
assertions.source: Closure gate: when this passes, every label-shaped witness is current with its content-block .md.  Currently informational; the production-side fix is rerunning each stale probe's producer.

description: I7 audit per local/compute-integration-watcher: every folio-assistant/computations/*.witness.json with a label-shaped `contentBlock` is cross-checked against the git-log mtime of its `.md` sibling.  A witness is stale if its `.md` was modified >7 days after the witness was last committed.  Operationalises the 86-hit I7 count from the 2026-05-18 idle sweep (PR #737).
